subject: CLOSE statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB140): the success halves were already verified (dissociation + no open mode, all three organizations; pb140_close_status pins the OPEN/CLOSE/CLOSE/OPEN cycle 00/00/42/00 through the FILE STATUS item). The disproved half - the sequential close path had NO failure boundary at all - is closed at the BASE: FileConnector.Close maps UnauthorizedAccessException/IOException to '30' (its OPEN twin's shape), _openMode clears on every completed close, and SequentialConnector.CloseCore nulls its streams in a finally, so a failed close leaves the connector dissociated, out of its open mode, with a recorded status the program can observe and retry. The siblings' per-connector catch arms and _open bits are deleted - ONE mechanism at the base.
